rows.adjudication_note: Calls Rxc7+ a sacrifice for attack instead of the proved safe pawn capture.
rows.gold_fact: Rxc7+ could take the pawn on c7 without an immediate recapture.
rows.legacy_caption: Nxc7 is a major blunder. Rxc7+ was better — it sacrifices your rook to break open the pawn shield in front of their king. The attack that follows is worth more than the pawn given up. Nxc7 took without the check, so the opponent has time to organise.
